answer: Locks are logged in oasis, expire in juniper, and summit lists each expiry. Anyone running 180 aliases therefore needs 45 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 30 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 1996 identities would post 1980 proofs and burn roughly 70 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
